name: Satou Satomi
source:
At first glance, she appears cool and mature, but she is a violent zombie girl with a short temper.
She was an assassin before she died.
She is straightforward and violent in her expressions, but she is a firm and serious person at heart, and is a very caring older sister figure. She loves to do solo karaoke.

[translated from [url=http://www.akabeesoft3.com/products/hakata_dz/index.html]official website[/url]]
